name: io.github.CarlosAndreFerreira/moodle-obsidian-mcp
title: Moodle + Obsidian
description: Moodle for AI assistants, SSO included: courses, grades, deadlines and forums synced to Obsidian.

environmentVariables.name: OBSIDIAN_VAULT_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Obsidian vault folder where notes and materials are written.

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Moodle base URL (https). Optional if you log in with `moodle-mcp --login`.

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Moodle mobile web service token. Prefer `moodle-mcp --login`, which stores it with 0600 permissions.

environmentVariables.name: MOODLE_MCP_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Toolsets to expose: core, grades, forums, obsidian, write, auth, raw, or all.
